papers.title: Classifying X-ray Binaries: A Probabilistic Approach
papers.abstract: In X-ray binary star systems consisting of a compact object that accretes material from an orbiting secondary star, there is no straightforward means to decide if the compact object is a black hole or a neutron star. To assist this classification, we develop a Bayesian statistical model that makes use of the fact that X-ray binary systems appear to cluster based on their compact object type when viewed from a 3-dimensional coordinate system derived from X-ray spectral data. The first coordinate of this data is the ratio of counts in mid to low energy band (color 1), the second coordinate is the ratio of counts in high to low energy band (color 2), and the third coordinate is the sum of counts in all three bands. We use this model to estimate the probabilities that an X-ray binary system contains a black hole, non-pulsing neutron star, or pulsing neutron star. In particular, we utilize a latent variable model in which the latent variables follow a Gaussian process prior distribution, and hence we are able to induce the spatial correlation we believe exists between systems of the same type. The utility of this approach is evidenced by the accurate prediction of system types using Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer All Sky Monitor data, but it is not flawless. In particular, non-pulsing neutron systems containing "bursters" that are close to the boundary demarcating systems containing black holes tend to be classified as black hole systems. As a byproduct of our analyses, we provide the astronomer with public R code that can be used to predict the compact object type of X-ray binaries given training data.

llm.relevance_to_user: 此论文研究X射线双星分类，与用户的研究方向（FEA代理模型、生物力学植入物设计）完全无关。

summary_zh.motivation: 辅助区分X射线双星中的黑洞和中子星
summary_zh.method: 基于高斯过程先验的潜变量贝叶斯模型
summary_zh.result: 能准确预测系统类型但对爆发源分类不完美
summary_zh.validation: 使用Rossi X射线时序探测器全天监测数据

summary_en.motivation: To assist in classifying compact objects in X-ray binaries as black holes or neutron stars.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian latent variable model with Gaussian process prior to capture spatial correlation.
summary_en.result: The model accurately predicts system types but struggles with non-pulsing neutron stars near the boundary.
summary_en.validation: Applied to Rossi X-ray Timing Explorer All Sky Monitor data.

papers.title: Finite element analysis for mechanical response of Ti foams with regular structure obtained by selective laser melting

corresponding_authors.name: Heung Nam Han

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了通过选区激光熔化制备的规则结构钛泡沫的力学响应，并与有限元分析进行了对比，但对疲劳性能和骨整合未涉及。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address fatigue, surface roughness, osseointegration, or specific hip implant stress shielding. The study is limited to static mechanical properties and regular pore structures.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究规则结构钛泡沫的力学行为及其与有限元模拟的对比。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化制备钛泡沫样品，结合有限元分析模拟力学响应。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了结构与力学性能之间的关系，验证了模拟的可靠性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验对SLM制备的试样进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical response of Ti foams with regular structure fabricated by selective laser melting and compare with finite element simulations.
summary_en.method: Finite element analysis was combined with experimental compression testing on SLM-produced Ti foam samples.
summary_en.result: The relationship between pore structure and mechanical properties was established, and the simulation was validated experimentally.
summary_en.validation: Compression tests on as-built specimens were used to validate the finite element model.

papers.title: Effects of different rhBMP-2 release profiles in defect areas around dental implants on bone regeneration.
papers.abstract: This study was undertaken to evaluate the effects of different rhBMP-2 release profiles in defect areas around dental implants on osseointegration and bone regeneration. Four beagle dogs (13-15 kg) were used. The defect was 3 mm deep and there was a 1 mm gap around the implant. Each of the four implants was installed on the right and left mandibular alveolar ridges. After the implants were placed, experimental groups were applied to the surrounding defect area (n = 8 in each group, the control group was not treated). The inject group was injected with rhBMP-2 solution directly. In the gel group, rhBMP-2 mixed with a hydrogel matrix was applied. In the particle-gel group, rhBMP-2-embedded poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid)(PLGA) microparticles mixed with hydrogel matrix were applied to maintain consistent release. Sequential fluorescent labeling and histological analysis were performed to evaluate the new bone formation and osseointegration in the defect area. In the control group, larger marginal bone loss was detected as compared with the other groups (P  <  0.05). The gel group showed significantly higher levels of BIC in the buccal and lingual defect areas compared with the other groups (P  <  0.05). New-bone percentages in the inject and gel groups formed more new bone than in the particle-gel and control groups (P  <  0.05). Despite the limitations of this study, the use of only hydrogel, which allows early release of rhBMP-2 followed by consistent extended release, showed better bone formation and osseointegration than simple injection or PLGA microparticles with hydrogel matrix.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究牙种植体周围rhBMP-2释放对骨再生的影响，与增材制造生物医用材料方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not involve LPBF fabrication, porous structure, mechanical testing, fatigue, stress shielding, or surface roughness characterization; it focuses on growth factor release kinetics.

summary_zh.motivation: 测试不同rhBMP-2释放模式对牙种植体周围骨再生的影响。
summary_zh.method: 比格犬模型，四种处理组：注射、水凝胶、微粒-水凝胶和对照。
summary_zh.result: 水凝胶组骨整合和骨生成最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 动物实验和组织学分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effects of different rhBMP-2 release profiles on bone regeneration around dental implants.
summary_en.method: Four beagle dogs received implants with control, injection, hydrogel, and PLGA microparticle-hydrogel treatments.
summary_en.result: The hydrogel group showed significantly higher bone-implant contact and new bone formation.
summary_en.validation: Validation through sequential fluorescent labeling and histological analysis in an animal model.
